mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2300 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2300, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals tightening monetary conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 5% are associated with strong labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 6-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) is growing at a rate above 2% YoY, the S&P 500 is likely to produce positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above $350B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and post-shock recoveries
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS > $350B in post-shock recovery regimes, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 180 is associated with decreased purchasing power, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between CPIAUCSL and inflation indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 180, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing at a rate above 1.5% MoM and unemployment rates (UNRATE) are below 4.5%, the S&P 500 is likely to produce positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals decreased economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between INDPRO and economic activity indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 3M MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
